description: This file is the entry point for a React-based web application. It imports React libraries, CSS styles, and the main App component, then renders the App component into the DOM.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a root container for a React application, enabling rendering of components into the DOM.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders the React component tree into the DOM node managed by the root.
